author: Ted Kalota
body: Very thoughtful analysis. I like how your commentary always takes a fresh look at nagging problems. I'm a fan thank you Stu.

author: Robert
body:
Congrats Stu on making the responsible move of selling your position when you were deep in the green. I caught up on all of your episodes recently and you stated you'd have a way to show us all what positions the show takes on prediction markets. I just want to make sure I am in the right place to receive that information (substack).

Proud to be one of the ground level audience members.

Boo eagles booooo

God bless you and your family.

author: Stu Burguiere
body: You’re in the right place!  And I will choose not to focus on your Eagles heresy.  Haha.  Thanks for coming over on the ground floor!

author: Ethan Protzel
body: Stu, I heard you explaining your definition of value on yesterday’s show and how on a 50/50 investment you anticipate loosing 50% of the time. It hit me that with this kind of strategy there has to be a certain volume of trades made to make it worth it. How many trades do you make in a day/week? How many hours is reasonable to devote?

author: Scott Hanson
body: Well ya 50:50 means it could go either way.
